messages:
Olivia CSM: quick follow-up on the repeated errors we saw for HarborPoint this week. saw two spikes Wed/Thu with increased 5xx and latency. https://redwood.app/tickets/INC-984

Ben Support: saw the spikes, root cause looked like autoscaler thrash + cache warmup on ded. short term workaround is to bump min replicas, long term is fix in autoscaler.

incidents-bot: alert summary: 2026-03-15 09:12Z - 5xx spike (p95 latency 1.2s -> 3.4s)

Priya Eng: confirmed. repro steps in staging: KV cache eviction during hot restart caused cold KV fetches. we have a patch that pins cache during rolling updates. will push canary tomorrow morning.

Olivia CSM: thanks. can we put clear owners + dates? cc @Ben Support @Priya Eng

Ben Support: owner for customer comms: Ben Support. I will send postmortem to Jamal and ops team by EOD Fri.

Priya Eng: engineering owner: Priya Eng. Canary push: 2026-03-16 08:00 PT. If stable for 4 hours we roll to prod 16:00 PT. rollback plan ready.

Olivia CSM: action items
- Ben: customer update + troubleshooting doc (due Fri EOD)
- Priya: canary push + verification steps (due Mon EOD if rollout delayed)
- Olivia: schedule weekly touchpoint with Jamal until stability confirmed (first call Mon)

Jamal (HarborPoint): appreciated — any ETA on when 503s should stop? our users spike in the morning window.

Priya Eng: after canary and prod roll we'll monitor for two morning windows. earliest likely Mon morning but aim to have prod roll same day 2026-03-16.

Olivia CSM: noted renewal-risks: keep on radar. If issues persist we'll escalate to Dedicated offering discussion.

Ben Support: attaching quick debug snippet I ran:
```
curl -s -X GET "https://harborpoint.api.redwood/v1/health" -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." | jq .latency_samples[-5:]
```

Priya Eng: telemetry we'll watch: p95 latency, 5xx rate, KV-miss ratio. set alert threshold to 0.5% 5xx for that customer.

Jamal (HarborPoint): thanks all. I'll wait for Ben's note and join Mon call. :thumbsup:

Olivia CSM: perfect. next check-in thread will include postmortem + metric graphs. tagging owners in the thread. :white_check_mark:
